name: Importance-Based Accumulated Transparency Modulation
definition: A rendering algorithm that generalizes MIDA by modulating the accumulated transparency with a factor β calculated from the difference between an importance measure of the incoming sample and the accumulated result along a viewing ray. It highlights features by modifying accumulated transparency rather than manipulating transfer functions.
summary: Importance-Based Accumulated Transparency Modulation is a volume rendering technique that highlights features by modulating only accumulated transparency based on importance differences, avoiding complex color tone-mapping.
